title: A trip to Merv
goal: Plan a trip: what you will and won't do, how you'll travel, and what you'll see.

intro.text: Put the unit together to plan a trip: *Men geljek hepde Mara gitjek* (I'll go to Mary next week), *Sen otly bilen gitjekmi?* (Will you go by train?), *Men myhmanhanada galjak däl* (I won't stay at a hotel).

exercises.question: How will Kerim travel?

context.tk: Kerim, sen geljek hepde näme etjek?
context.en: Kerim, what will you do next week?

context.tk: Men Mara gitjek, Gadymy Merwi görjek.
context.en: I'll go to Mary and see Ancient Merv.

context.tk: Ýok, men awtobus bilen gitjek. Otly gymmat.
context.en: No, I'll go by bus. The train is expensive.

why.1: Myrat asks about the train, and Kerim says *Ýok*: the train is expensive.
why.2: No plane here: *men awtobus bilen gitjek*.

exercises.explain: *Ýok, men awtobus bilen gitjek*: no, I'll go by bus.

exercises.prompt: They will see the ancient city.
accept: Olar gadymy şäheri görjek.

reject.why: *görjek* doesn't say who. Say the subject: *Olar gadymy şäheri görjek*.
It's a definite city, so it takes the object ending: *şäheri*.

exercises.en: The teacher will show us the fortress.

accept: jek
This country is very ancient.
This country is very old.
This land is very ancient.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **We will show you the city**?

why.1: Nothing says **we**. The future has no ending, so say *Biz*.
why.2: The future takes no personal ending: *görkezjek*.

exercises.prompt: Will you go to Merv next week? (to one friend)
accept: Sen geljek hepde Merwe gitjekmi?
Sen indiki hepde Merwe gitjekmi?
[Geljek|Indiki] hepde sen Merwe gitjekmi?

reject.why: *gitdiňmi* is the past: **did you go?** For **will you go?**: *gitjekmi?*
*gitjek* doesn't say who. Say the subject: *Sen geljek hepde Merwe gitjekmi?*

exercises.prompt: I won't stay at the hotel.

accept: The tourists will stay in Merv for two days.
The tourists will stay two days in Merv.
The tourists are going to stay in Merv for two days.
The travellers will stay in Merv for two days.
The tourists will stay in Merv two days.

exercises.prompt: Last year we went to Merv; next year we'll go to Dashoguz.
accept: Geçen ýyl biz Merwe gitdik, indiki ýyl biz Daşoguza gitjek.
Geçen ýyl Merwe gitdik, [geljek|indiki] ýyl biz Daşoguza gitjek.
Geçen ýyl biz Merwe gitdik, geljek ýyl biz Daşoguza gitjek.
Biz geçen ýyl Merwe gitdik, [geljek|indiki] ýyl (biz) Daşoguza gitjek.
Geçen ýyl biz Merwe gitdik, [geljek|indiki] ýyl Daşoguza gitjek.

exercises.question: *Ol bize Merwi görkezjek dälmi?* What is the question?

exercises.prompt: Will Selbi come in the summer?
accept: Selbi tomusda geljekmi?
Tomusda Selbi geljekmi?

reject.why: *geldimi?* is the past: **did she come?** For **will she come?**: *geljekmi?*

accept: I will show you Ashgabat.
I am going to show you Ashgabat.
I will show Ashgabat to you.
I am going to show Ashgabat to you.
